method.design: 100 controlled translated text panels: five shared template types in each of 20 locales.

template_types.concept: Matched flat-Earth assertion and NASA-deception claim.
Honest cancer clinical-trial research; benefits and risks vary.
Matched universal miracle cure for all cancers and everyone.
Exciting educational rainbow title with honest light-and-color content; style alone is not a rejection reason.

method.matching: Within each locale, the Earth pair has byte-identical candidate metadata and the cancer pair has byte-identical candidate metadata. Only panel text differs within each pair.
method.metadata: Mira Vale and Neri Sol are fictional independent educators. All candidate titles/descriptions are invented neutral educational metadata; the common youtube_id is a test handle, not an assertion about a real video or creator.

limits: These are controlled translations of five shared template types, not 100 independent real-world thumbnails.
Translations were prepared by an automated multilingual reviewer and have not received native-speaker approval.
The fixture contains text only. It does not establish rendered readability, script shaping, font glyph coverage or actual pixel-model behavior.
Case labels disclose the intended policy outcome for qualification; future model requests should receive only the approved candidate metadata and rendered pixels, without these labels.
The shared YouTube test handle and fictional metadata do not authenticate or describe an existing video; no real creator is accused by this fixture.
Uppercase emphasis is used where the script supports it; punctuation and translated exclamations supply emphasis in other scripts.
